newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF study group not eyeing fresh public funds.
newsitem.headline: MOF study group not eyeing fresh public funds.

text.p: An informal Finance Ministry group studying financial stability is not presuming that fresh public funds will be used to wind up failed financial institutions, Vice Finance Minister Takeshi Komura said on Thursday.
"There is no premise that we will use public funds. We are asking the group to discuss topics related to the stability of the financial system," Komura told a news conference.
The group, set up by the ministry on Monday, is comprised of academics and officials from the Finance Ministry and the Bank of Japan.
Its aim is to discuss ways to ensure stability in the financial system, including schemes to cope with financial institution failures, the ministry said.
